item.title: Sheriff's office says woman in her 60s found dead in Travis County homicide
item.description: The Travis County Sheriff's Office said early Tuesday afternoon that it was investigating a homicide.

item.title: The candidates vying to become Texas' next attorney general, an office Paxton made controversial
item.description: As the race to replace Ken Paxton as Texas' next attorney general begins to take shape, his eventual successor will step into a statewide office with a national spotlight -- one that has, for many years, become hyper political and, under Paxton, increasingly controversial.

item.title: Travis County DA not pursuing charges against officers in downtown Austin mass shooting
item.description: The Travis County District Attorney’s Office said it’s not seeking any charges against Austin Police officers who shot and killed the gunman in Sunday’s mass shooting on West Sixth Street.

item.title: Why Tuesday is likely the first of two primaries for the Texas Republican Senate race
item.description: The 2026 U.S. Senate race in Texas is shaping up to be a highly contested election between Republican Sen. John Cornyn, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, and U.S. Rep. Wesley Hunt, with the potential for a runoff between the top two candidates.

item.title: Wettest pattern of 2026 ramps up starting tomorrow
item.description: Isolated thunderstorms may re-develop later Wednesday afternoon into the early evening as some afternoon sunshine tries to destabilize the atmosphere. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Paxton forces runoff against Cornyn in Texas Republican Senate Primary
item.description: Senator John Cornyn and Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton will face off in a runoff election on May 26, 2026, after neither candidate received over half of the vote in the Republican primary for U.S. Senate.

item.title: Crockett v. Talarico: Texas Democrats battle for a chance at flipping a U.S. Senate seat
item.description: Former colleagues in the Texas House of Representatives face off Tuesday night to see who will represent the Democratic Party in the race for the U.S. Senate. A Democratic candidate has not won a statewide election in Texas in three decades.

item.title: Abbott projected as GOP nominee for governor; set to face Hinojosa in November
item.description: Incumbent Gov. Greg Abbott is set for a run at a fourth term after winning the GOP nomination on Tuesday, according to Associated Press Projections. On the Democratic side, Texas Rep. Gina Hinojosa, D-Austin, is the projected winner.
